latest_release.body:
### Release Notes for [3.1.1](https://github.com/doctrine/collections/milestone/49)

3.1.x bugfix release (patch)

### 3.1.1

- Total issues resolved: **0**
- Total pull requests resolved: **3**
- Total contributors: **2**

#### Bugfixes

 - [555: Relax types for expressions](https://github.com/doctrine/collections/pull/555) thanks to @greg0ire
 - [563: Use spl_object_id instead of deprecated spl_object_hash](https://github.com/doctrine/collections/pull/563) thanks to @DavidPrevot 

#### CI

 - [558: Setup dependabot for PHP](https://github.com/doctrine/collections/pull/558) thanks to @greg0ire



#### Static Analysis

 - [551: Refine return type annotation in Selectable interface for improved type hints for IDE](https://github.com/doctrine/collections/pull/551) thanks to @dmitryuk
